cardiff_boutique_keeper.text: Shw mae! The arcades are Victorian and the shops are older than my patience. Have a look.

then.text: That {worn_coat}. Proper. You'd see off a Cardiff drizzle with that.
I like your {worn_hat}. It's got a whiff of Saturday at the Millennium Stadium.
That {worn_top} suits you. Now, what goes with it?
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: No hat, no coat, nothing special. Bit of a blank canvas, aren't you, cariad?

cardiff_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
